capabilities.claim: The package installs and exposes the documented skill-native CLI.
The exact installed Python dependency set is persisted with the receipt.
The complete Python test suite executes on the bound subject.
The merged Android contract and compile boundary execute their deterministic tests.
The Cloudflare Sandbox Worker and Dynamic Worker TypeScript contracts install and typecheck on the bound subject.
notes: Typecheck proves contract compilation only; it is not account-backed Cloudflare runtime evidence.

capabilities.claim: Generated public schemas exactly match the committed schemas.
The adversarial fixture corpus can be materialized through the public CLI.
The Coding Harness validates, compiles, executes under FakeRuntime, and emits persisted evidence and verdict objects.
notes: FakeRuntime evidence never establishes sandbox isolation.

capabilities.claim: Evaluator-authorized Run Artifact Bundle construction executes and persists its graph, replay, trace, and scorecard objects.
The exact Run Artifact Bundle can be signed, policy-verified, appended to the local log, and receipt-verified using an ephemeral local Ed25519 key bound to the audit commit metadata.
notes: This is not GitHub OIDC/keyless signing.
The private key must not be published.

capabilities.claim: A real Chromium process executes the deterministic Browser Harness and persists its result, evidence, verdict, and artifacts.
A public mutable GitHub Skill reference resolves to an immutable commit and persisted provenance.
The packaged CLI executes inside a content-addressed hardened Linux container with network disabled and a read-only root filesystem.
The sandbox positive control can write only to the declared ephemeral tmpfs.
A real outbound socket probe is denied by the container network boundary.
A real write probe against the container root filesystem is denied.
The exact subject executes on a real NVIDIA OpenShell runtime and persists required OCSF/policy/runtime evidence.
The exact subject executes on an admitted Cloudflare Sandbox or Dynamic Worker endpoint and persists cold/warm, egress, resource, and credential-isolation evidence.
A real admitted inference provider or local endpoint produces run-linked token, latency, quota, cost, and failure receipts.
A trusted ADB runner executes against a scripted ADB, emulator, or physical device and persists independently classified Android evidence.
Ranking is computed from adequate persisted Skill × Agent × Runtime × Model live sample cells with uncertainty.
The signed statement is included in an independently witnessed public transparency service.

non_claims: A passing FakeRuntime run is not sandbox verification.
A GitHub-hosted Docker container is not NVIDIA OpenShell and does not close Issue #1.
A local deterministic Chromium loopback is not an isolated, public-site, credentialed-site, or production browser claim.
Cloudflare TypeScript typechecks or deployment configuration are not account-backed Cloudflare runtime evidence.
An ephemeral local Ed25519 key is not GitHub OIDC/keyless identity.
A local hash-chain/Merkle log is not an independently witnessed public transparency log.
Android contract/compile tests are not ADB, emulator, or physical-device execution.
One successful run is not adequate multi-cell ranking evidence.
